job.title: Ops Manager
job.description:
Fully Remote | €65,000–€75,000

We’re partnering with an exciting, growing business to recruit an Operations Manager to join their fully remote team. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, proactive operator who enjoys bringing structure to a business, improving processes and making a tangible impact.

With a team of approximately 25 people, the business is looking for someone who can take ownership of day-to-day operations, supporting both finance and HR functions, with a particular focus on finance operations. This role offers the opportunity to step in, take responsibility and make an immediate impact.

The Role

Reporting to the COO, you’ll play a key role in ensuring the business runs smoothly and efficiently. Working closely with the finance team you’ll provide essential operational support while overseeing a range of HR and wider business activities.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Finance Operations: Support the CFO and finance team with day-to-day operational requirements, ensuring processes run efficiently and the team has what it needs to succeed.
  • HR Operations: Coordinate and manage day-to-day HR processes, helping ensure a smooth employee experience.
  • Team & Business Logistics: Organise team logistics and coordinate the practicalities that keep a fully remote business running effectively.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve efficiencies and introduce better ways of working.
  • AI & Technology: Make effective use of AI tools and emerging technologies to automate tasks, improve productivity and enhance operational processes.
  • General Business Support: Take ownership of operational priorities, anticipate requirements and ensure important tasks are followed through to completion.

Requirements:

We’re keen to speak with candidates who are practical, solutions-focused and comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing business where no two days are necessarily the same.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Previous experience in a similar Operations Manager or business operations role within a small or medium-sized company.
  • Strong experience across finance operations, with additional exposure to HR operations.
  • Experience working in a fully remote environment and the ability to manage your workload independently.
  • A proactive approach to AI, automation and using technology to work smarter.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong initiative, sound judgement and a common-sense approach to problem-solving.
  • A hands-on mindset, someone who rolls up their sleeves, takes ownership and gets things done.
  • The confidence to work with senior stakeholders and support a finance function without needing to manage a team directly.

What’s on Offer?

  • Salary of €65,000–€75,000, depending on experience.
  • Fully remote working.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a growing business.
  • A broad, varied role with real ownership across finance, HR and business operations.
  • The chance to introduce new ideas, improve processes and help shape how the business operates.

Interested?

If you’re an ambitious, hands-on operations professional who enjoys taking initiative, improving how businesses work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity.

job.title: Senior NPI Engineer
job.description:
A growing medical device company with a facility based in Dublin are seeking an experienced medical device development engineer to join their team. This is a permanent role.

As the Senior New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer you will lead the production oversight and develop the manufacturing processes for an implantable device. You will support a team of operators & product builders to meet production objectives and troubleshoot on the line.

This is a hands-on engineering role and is ideal for an experienced engineer who is passionate about designing & building components & fixtures and implementing new processes into a manufacturing line.

Responsibilities:

  • Design & develop manufacturing processes including FMEAs, equipment qualifications, process validations, test methods.
  • Oversee production on a daily basis including support & training to operators.
  • Source, design and implement tooling, instruments and technologies into the manufacturing process.
  • Develop process & materials specifications and associated documentation.
  • Design & execute DoEs for manufacturing processes.
  • Work with suppliers and contract manufacturers related to manufacturing processes and materials.
  • Continuous improvement activities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelors or Masters in engineering such as mechanical, biomedical or related.
  • A minimum of 5 years experience as an engineer in the medical device industry within NPI, manufacturing, R&D, process engineering or related.
  • Use of Solidworks
  • DoE, root cause analysis and problem solving skills
  • Process validation experience is an advantage

  • 🚨 Investigate complex security incidents and improve response capabilities

  • 🛡️ Design and implement robust security controls

job.title: Digital Project Delivery Lead
job.description:
We’re Hiring: Digital Project Delivery Lead 🚀

📍 Location: Dublin, Ireland

💼 Type: Permanent

📈 Reports To: Chief Operating Officer


About the Role

Are you a practical construction troubleshooter who knows how sites actually run?

We are a vertically integrated residential developer-builder with a large pipeline of active schemes across Ireland. We’re looking for a Digital Project Delivery Lead to fill an unusual, high-impact dual mandate: solve real operational friction on live sites, and turn those solutions into software.

You’ll sit at the intersection of live construction site operations and product engineering—embedding alongside QSs, construction managers, and site leads to fix bottlenecks, while translating those hard-won learnings into structured requirements for an affiliated AI/proptech engineering team.

Responsibilities:

  • 🛠️ Troubleshoot on Site: Embed into live residential schemes to identify and fix high-cost, high-friction operational bottlenecks from tender through to handover.
  • 🌉 Bridge Operations & Tech: Translate real-world construction challenges into structured workflows and product requirements for software/AI engineering teams.
  • 🤖 Drive AI Adoption: Roll out in-house digital and AI tools directly into site workflows, measuring success by actual productivity gains—not just tool deployment.
  • 📊 Deliver Clear Insights: Surface data-driven insights that give site leads and executive management clear visibility on time and cost metrics.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in construction delivery, digital construction, or project controls (residential or large-scale build experience preferred).
  • A proven track record of stepping onto a live site, diagnosing operational friction, and fixing it fast.
  • Ability to speak both "site" and "software"—translating messy site realities into clear product specs.
  • Deep familiarity with standard construction stacks: BIM/CDE (ISO 19650), ACC, Asta Powerproject, CostX, and Power BI.
  • Practical understanding of the Irish construction market and delivery environment.

Why Join?

  • Direct Impact: See your site fixes directly hit the P&L and shape next-generation construction tech.
  • Flexibility: A fractional arrangement that can adapt to fit around your commitments as the platform scales.
  • Cutting-Edge Stack: Work directly at the intersection of live developer-builder operations and agentic AI.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel
job.description:
Our client, a Dublin based Asset Management Company is seeking to recruit a senior Legal Counsel.

The Role
We are looking to recruit a Legal Counsel to join our Legal Team. This role will report into the Head of Legal. We are looking for a candidate who not only is familiar with UCIT and AIFs and engaging with the Central Bank on Irish fund authorisations but who ideally also has experience with debt issuances and the relevant documents required to issue such securities.

Main Responsibilities:
  • Legislation and Regulation - Follow-up, analysis and implementation of new legislation or regulatory requirements impacting the Asset Manager and the funds under management (such as the UCITS Directives, AIFMD, MiFID II, EMIR, SFDR, CP86 and outsourcing requirements).
  • Fund Approvals/Amendments – Complete Central Bank and CSSF applications for new sub-funds and manage all post authorisation fund amendments with the Central Bank or the CSSF. Generally assist with the Asset Manager’s product development right from idea stage through to fully managing the new product approval process with the regulator and internal and external stakeholders;
  • Fund Documentation – Draft and maintain fund and management company documents (e.g.Prospectus, Supplements, KIIDs/KIDs and Business Plan) and other ancillary documents related to the investment funds under management;
  • Contracts - Draft and review a range of commercial contracts impacting the Asset Manager and the funds under management (such as IMAs with third party managers, investment advisory agreements and licensing agreements);
  • Transactional Documentation: Draft and review fund transactional documentation (such as ISDA Agreements, transaction confirmations, ISDA amendment agreements and give-up agreements);
  • Legal Advice – Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice on issues that arise for the Asset Manager in the context of its Irish and Luxembourg fund umbrellas and in respect of the Asset Manager’s own management company governance requirements;
  • Projects - Participation in ad-hoc regulatory and business projects;
  • Board and the Asset Manager Committee Preparation and Attendance – Assist internal stakeholders and the Company Secretary in respect of preparing and organising quarterly and ad hoc board meetings and attend to present topics as needed; and
  • Representation– Represent the Asset Manager at external conferences, industry events or fund association events.
Key requirements:
  • Qualified Irish Solicitor or a solicitor with equivalent qualification in another jurisdiction with 6+ years' post qualification experience (gained working in Ireland specifically).
  • Previous experience in investment funds is essential, with a demonstratable background in the understanding of investment strategies and subsequent drafting of fund product documentation.
  • Highly motivated, pragmatic, solutions-oriented and a real business partner.
  • Ability to conduct a thorough legal analysis of complex topics and translate this analysis into practical and succinct legal advice.
  • Commitment to high standards and forensic attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written) and ability to liaise with top management and other stakeholders.
  • Independent worker, with the organisational and task management skills necessary to manage a large volume of tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to effectively prioritise work by understanding competing priorities and make appropriate judgments regarding relative importance.
  • Team player, offers to help colleagues and share work.
  • Familiar with MS-applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

  • Experience working with multiple entities, ideally within a multinational environment
  • Strong audit and statutory reporting experience
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A commercially minded, proactive approach to process improvement

This would suit an experienced Group Accountant / Financial Reporting Manager / Finance Manager who is ready to take the next step and have genuine ownership within an international organisation.

job.title: Life Science Solicitor
job.description:
Our client, a Top Tier firm are seeking to hire an ambitious Solicitor, NQ-3 years PQE, to join their Life Sciences Team focusing on the areas of regulatory & compliance, and product liability.

The successful candidate will advise Irish and international clients, as well as law firms, on EU and Irish pharmaceutical and healthcare regulatory frameworks and compliance matters across the healthcare, BioPharma, MedTech, animal health, food, and cosmetics sectors.
Note this is not a medical negligence role.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Product classification, authorisation/certification and regulatory requirements throughout the life cycle of each relevant product.
  • Promotion, marketing, advertising and hospitality, regulatory requirements, prohibitions and restrictions, codes of practice of industry bodies (medicinal products and medical devices) regulatory guidance and advising on compliance and enforcement risks.
  • Licensing, registration, certification and other requirements for manufacturing facilities and activities (MIA, controlled drugs, substances, APIs and chemicals), wholesale distribution facilities (WDA) and supply chain, brokers of medicinal products, laboratory facilities and compliance with GMP and GDP.
  • CE marking and advice on the requirements of MDR and IVDR for all actors within the medical device supply chain.
  • Market access, pricing and reimbursement, applications to the HSE under the Health (Pricing and Supply of Medical Goods) Act 2013 to gain reimbursement status for medicines, medical devices, special dietary foods etc and on responding to the HSE in respect of price reviews, pricing strategies of the HSE Medicines Management Programme and other pricing initiatives and requests for price reductions. Advising on the IPHA and MFI Framework Agreements for the Supply of Medicines to the HSE.
  • Responding to regulatory authorities, conformity assessment bodies, and governmental authorities including HPRA, HIQA, Department of Health and the HSE in respect of adverse findings on inspection, audit and in respect of reviews, inquiries and investigations.
  • Irish medical and healthcare law, telemedicine, digital health, and cross border healthcare.
  • Work closely with the firm’s corporate teams advising clients on the establishment of operations in Ireland and on the regulatory aspects of structuring and due diligence in corporate transactions in the regulated sectors supported by the Healthcare and Life Sciences team
  • On the contentious side the successful candidate will represent manufacturers and producers in the defence of product liability claims.
  • Advise on notifications to competent authorities, product withdrawal and recall in the regulated sectors supported by the Healthcare and Life Sciences team.
Requirements:
  • Demonstrates sectoral interest and relevant experience in their career to date - as a trainee and as a qualified solicitor.
  • Possesses excellent academic achievements and technical legal ability in areas relevant to the sectors supported by the Healthcare and Life Sciences Team and role.
  • Deals with legal concepts and technical complexity comfortably.
  • Conducts research thoroughly, accurately and demonstrates strong and consistent attention to detail.
  • Is a clear and concise communicator.
  • Constructs clear advice for clients responding to client’s requirements in a timely way.
  • Is comfortable working within challenging deadlines to meet client requirements.
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively with the Healthcare and Life Sciences Team and across the firm.

job.title: Head of Financial Institution Sales (EMEA)
job.description:
Regional Head of Financial Institution Sales – EMEA

Location: London. However, candidates based elsewhere in the UK or Europe will also be considered

The business is seeking a senior commercial leader to take ownership of Financial Institution sales and strategic partnerships across EMEA. Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a highly autonomous, hands-on role for an established commercial operator who can bring a strong network and convert relationships into significant, long-term revenue opportunities.

This is not a high-volume or lead-generation-focused sales position. The successful candidate will originate, structure and close a small number of high-value partnerships across banking, payments, fintech, treasury services, cross-border FX and, potentially, digital assets.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full commercial lifecycle, from origination and initial engagement through negotiation, implementation and revenue generation
  • Build and convert a regional pipeline of large Financial Institution and B2B partnerships
  • Develop senior relationships across banks, payment processors, fintechs, FX providers and large corporate treasury functions
  • Present cross-border payments, FX and payment infrastructure solutions to C-suite stakeholders
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations and structure tailored client propositions
  • Work closely with Product, Risk, Compliance and Finance to bring partnerships live
  • Take ownership of regional revenue, payment-volume and partnership-development targets
  • Represent the business as a trusted adviser within the European payments and financial services ecosystem

The successful candidate will likely have:

  • Significant senior-level experience in institutional sales, treasury sales, payments, banking, fintech or strategic partnerships
  • A strong and demonstrable network across Financial Institutions, payments, fintech or corporate treasury
  • A track record of personally originating and closing large, complex commercial partnerships
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payments, FX, treasury services or payment infrastructure
  • Credibility when engaging and negotiating with CFOs, treasurers and other C-suite decision-makers
  • The ability to operate independently and establish a regional commercial presence
  • Exposure to stablecoins or digital assets would be beneficial but is not essential

This is initially a senior individual-contributor position, with the opportunity to play a central role in establishing and developing the organisation’s EMEA commercial presence.

job.title: Funds Professional Support Lawyer
job.description:
Asset Management and Investment Funds Professional Support Lawyer

Our client a top tier firm is seeking to recruit a Professional Support Lawyer to join its Tier 1 Asset Management and Investment Funds (AMIF) department.

Responsibilities:

  • To keep fee earners in the AMIF group up to speed on legal and regulatory developments, including pipeline developments.
  • To assist AMIF fee earners in respect of technical and/or practical legal issues raised by clients, and to assist in the development of practice notes, toolkits and other legal know how.

  • To capture and disseminate relevant legal knowledge to ensure that the collective expertise and knowledge of the AMIF group is supported, increased, understood, and shared.
